sections.1_problem: Implantable devices (sensors, valves, drug-delivery actuators) need power for years without percutaneous leads or repeated battery-revision surgery; battery volume dominates device size and revision risk. The frozen dossier targets the implanted-shunt power problem (the >= 500 uW device target class).
sections.2_existing_limitation: Existing transcutaneous power approaches (inductive coupling, battery, wired) trade depth/alignment sensitivity against device volume and revision surgery; per-cutaneous leads carry infection risk. No documented 940 nm GaAs photovoltaic transcranial power-delivery architecture was found in the closest prior art (PatentBear specific-mechanism query: 0 hits; closest reference lacks all 5 mapped elements — see NOVELTY_ASSESSMENT.json).
sections.3_proposed_technology: An implanted GaAs photovoltaic receiver (shipped geometry: 7 mm cell on substrate under hermetic encapsulation) powered by an external 940 nm near-infrared source through the tissue path, delivering electrical power to the implanted device function.
sections.4_mechanism: Optical chain: source -> Beer-Lambert tissue transmission I(d) = I0*exp(-mu_eff*d) (mu_eff 1.0-2.5 /cm at 940 nm, Jacques 2013) -> PV-surface fluence -> GaAs photovoltaic conversion -> conditioned electrical power (EQ-1/EQ-2/EQ-3 in the frozen equation registry). The complete stage-by-stage chain with every loss and evidence class is assembled in ENERGY_BUDGET.json v2.0: the fluence chain is now ARCHIVED (R310/R311/R312 simulation artifacts restored with hash custody), the historical ~1050 uW figure is RECONCILED (it was the 1 cm² / 100 %-conversion reference-detector conversion, never a claim about the shipped receiver), the canonical deliverable power is UNKNOWN, and the conditional modelled band for the shipped receiver is 121-163 uW under stated assumptions.
sections.5_evidence: 3 governing equations; 9 design inputs; 6 failure modes; parametric CAD shipped and VALID (receiver area grown 19.635 -> 38.4845 mm², KEEP, measured on built solid; independently re-measured at R404 by fresh deterministic rebuild); tissue-optics simulation chain PRE-REGISTERED (R310 preregistration, hash-bound to its result) and EXECUTED — the artifacts are ARCHIVED and restored (VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE/: R310 4-model disagreement map with MC convergence 1.049054 mW/cm² and MC-vs-MC agreement 0.11 %; R311 ACTUAL PyTissueOptics v2.0.1 execution 1.415645 mW/cm²; R312 convergence ladder with CI-overlap verdict) — all CPU-mode simulation, MCX (GPU) never run (documented CUDA constraint), zero physical measurement of tissue; the deliverable electrical power is UNKNOWN (targeted-cell efficiency, encapsulation and power electronics all UNKNOWN) with conditional modelled band 121-163 uW under stated assumptions (ENERGY_BUDGET canonical calculation).
